name: wormzilla.io
summary: Wormzilla.io is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer .io game set in a massive arena. Players control giant worms, consuming resources to grow larger while strategically outmaneuvering opponents to dominate the leaderboard. With its smooth mechanics and intense survival gameplay, Wormzilla.io offers a thrilling battle royale experience directly in your browser. Rise to the top, trap your enemies, and become the ultimate apex predator!
